title: FUNDING OPPORTUNITY: Learn more at the November 21st, 2025 Webinar!
bodyHtml:
‼️New Funding Opportunity Alert‼️

Curious about how your research could earn part of an $850,000 cash prize? Join the Common Fund Data Ecosystem Public Webinar to learn how YOU can apply!

If you're passionate about rigor, reproducibility, and accelerating scientific impact, this is a chance you don’t want to miss.

? Friday, November 21, 2025
? 1–2 PM ET
? $850K in total prizes available

This session will walk through: 

  • Submission requirements
  • Key timelines
  • Incentives
  • Tips for a successful application

Register for the webinar

Apply to the NIH Common Fund Replication Prize: https://bit.ly/3ICAkc1
summary: Funding Opportunity Available: NIH Common Fund Replication Prize. Learn more at the November 21st, 2025 Webinar!
